scripts.deploy:bsc: gcloud run deploy unrekt-telbot-bsc --source . --region us-central1 --platform managed --allow-unauthenticated --env-vars-file environment/bsc.yaml --memory 1Gi --cpu 1 --max-instances 1 --min-instances 1 --no-cpu-throttling --cpu-boost --add-cloudsql-instances "$CLOUDSQL_INSTANCE"
scripts.deploy:solana: gcloud run deploy unrekt-telbot-solana --source . --region us-central1 --platform managed --allow-unauthenticated --env-vars-file environment/solana.yaml --memory 1Gi --cpu 1 --max-instances 1 --min-instances 0 --cpu-throttling --no-cpu-boost --add-cloudsql-instances "$CLOUDSQL_INSTANCE"
scripts.deploy: echo 'Please specify chain: npm run deploy:bsc or npm run deploy:solana'
